incident.description:
The quarterly data-governance review, initiated after automated external-sharing alerts, has flagged several sensitive resources as over-exposed: they are shared more broadly than their intended audience.

Flagged resources:
  - SharePoint site 'Corporate Finance'
  - SharePoint site 'Deal Room - Project Titan'
  - OneDrive folder 'Board Materials' (Marcus Bell)
  - OneDrive file 'Project Titan - Financial Model.xlsx' (Marcus Bell)
  - OneDrive folder 'Project Titan - Due Diligence' (Marcus Bell)

For each flagged resource, bring the sharing back to least exposure so that only the intended audience retains access, while preserving legitimate, business-justified access. The data classification and ownership of record for each resource is maintained in the CMDB. Close this ticket when the review is complete.
incident.short_description: Data governance review — sensitive resources shared beyond intended audience
